cancellation.title: Cancel this task?
cancellation.message: Only the task below will be canceled. Its queued work will stop and any active trial will close. Existing drafts and review history will remain. This does not approve or qualify the work.
cancellation.canceled: Task cancellation confirmed. Existing drafts and review history are preserved.
cancellation.unconfirmed: Cancellation is unconfirmed. Refresh the task before trying again. No retry was sent automatically.
cancellation.unavailable: This task cannot be canceled right now. Refresh its status and check your founder access.

dictation.unsupported: Voice transcription is unavailable in this browser. You can still type your message.
dictation.denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the browser to use voice transcription.
dictation.noSpeech: No speech was detected. Try again or type your message.
dictation.audio: No microphone is available. Check your microphone and try again.
dictation.network: The browser speech service could not connect. Your draft has been kept.
dictation.failed: Voice transcription could not start. Your draft has been kept.
dictation.limit: The message length limit has been reached. Review or shorten the draft.
dictation.notice: The browser may process audio through its speech service. Text stays in the draft; nothing is sent to Steve.
dictation.service: The browser blocked its speech-recognition service. Microphone permission alone does not enable that service. Your draft has been kept.

labels.title: HQ meeting
labels.demonstrationNotice: Synthetic demonstration: identities come from a dated registry snapshot; replies and tasks are synthetic. No live model or employee is connected.
labels.microphoneConsent: I allow microphone capture for on-device recognition.
labels.microphoneDisclosure: Audio is processed on this device. HQ does not retain raw audio. Recognized text is a draft: review it and press Send contribution yourself.
labels.holdOnDisconnect: Hold undispatched work until an explicit decision.
labels.retention: Sent meeting text, replies and decisions are retained in the room database. HQ does not retain raw audio. Transcript deletion is not enabled.
labels.closeNotice: Closing this panel does not end or approve the meeting.
labels.question: Question and scope
labels.approveOnEnd: Approve and start when meeting ends
labels.approvalNotice: Only explicit approval of this exact version grants its defined scope. Ending or disconnecting never implies approval.
labels.approvalConfirmation: Confirm this exact version and scope.
labels.liveScopeNotice: Assignments can read approved sources with no additional spend and independent review. Each worker job allows up to 600 seconds. Dependencies, blockers and whole-task deadlines are not supported.
labels.liveSourceNotice: Replies and findings appear after correlated worker output is saved. Staff qualifications and the existing authorized runtime are required.
labels.microphoneReadyLocal: Voice recognition is ready. Microphone off.
labels.microphoneUnsupported: This browser cannot run on-device voice recognition. Use a supported secure browser or continue with text.
labels.microphoneInsecure: Microphone capture requires a secure browser context. Open HQ through its supported secure or localhost address.
labels.microphoneCaptureUnavailable: Microphone capture is unavailable in this browser. Check the input device and browser access, or use text.
labels.microphoneLocalUnsupported: This browser cannot use on-device speech recognition. Microphone permission alone does not enable it. Use text or explicitly select the browser speech service if available.
labels.microphoneLanguageUnavailable: On-device speech recognition is unavailable for this language in this browser. Microphone permission is separate. Use text or explicitly choose the browser speech service.
labels.microphoneLanguageDownloadable: The browser needs a downloaded language pack before on-device recognition can start. HQ does not download packs automatically. Use text, or explicitly choose the browser speech service.
labels.microphoneLanguageDownloading: The on-device language pack is still downloading. Recheck when it finishes, or use text.
labels.microphoneSupportUnverified: Speech support could not be checked. Recheck support or use text.
labels.microphonePolicyBlocked: The browser blocked the speech support check. Check the browser or page policy, then recheck. Text remains available.
labels.microphonePermissionDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the site settings in your browser, then start again. Your draft has been kept.
labels.microphoneDeviceUnavailable: No usable microphone was found. Check or connect the input device, then start again.
labels.microphoneInputEnded: Microphone input stopped. Check the device, then start again. Your draft has been kept.
labels.microphoneServiceBlocked: The browser blocked its speech-recognition service. Microphone permission alone does not enable that service. Your draft has been kept.
labels.microphoneRecognitionFailed: Voice recognition stopped unexpectedly. Review your draft and prepare again if needed, or use text.
labels.microphoneNetworkFailed: The speech-recognition service reported a connection failure. Start again or use text. Your draft has been kept.
labels.microphoneNoSpeech: No speech was detected. Start again when you are ready.
labels.microphoneLanguageError: The voice engine could not recognize this audio as Arabic or English. Try a shorter phrase with a pause, or use text.
labels.microphoneLimit: Recognition reached its text limit. Your existing draft was kept. Review it before starting again.
labels.microphoneConsentRequired: Choose a recognition option, accept its audio disclosure, then press Start microphone.
labels.automaticRecognitionNotice: Arabic and English are detected automatically. Pause briefly when switching languages and review the transcript before sending.
labels.recognitionDownloadConsent: I agree to download the voice recognition model (about 80 MB plus runtime).
labels.recognitionDownloadNotice: The multilingual model and runtime download from public model hosts after you agree. Recognition then runs on this device. HQ does not retain raw audio.
labels.recognitionModelRequired: Prepare voice recognition before starting the microphone. Text remains available.
labels.recognitionLoading: Loading the voice recognition model on this device…
labels.recognitionModelFailed: Voice recognition could not be prepared. Check the connection, browser storage and device support, then prepare again. Text remains available.
labels.recognitionModelConsentRequired: Agree to the model download before preparing voice recognition.
labels.workerUpgradeRequired: This participant needs the meeting worker upgrade before it can reply. Upgrade the worker and send the message again.
labels.meetingSetupRequired: The meeting backend is not ready. Sign in with the founder account and complete the meeting setup, then refresh.
labels.contributionTooLong: This draft is longer than 4,000 characters. Shorten it before sending; the full draft has been kept.
labels.recognitionModelReady: Voice recognition model is ready on this device.
